simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 15:5. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, mountain.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows נָבַט through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
